headline: Every treat tells a story
intro: At CCerenity's, every treat tells a story — one baked with love, creativity, and a dash of nostalgia. What began as a simple passion for homemade treats in a Fort Wayne kitchen has blossomed into a local favorite for those who crave sweetness with heart. Come taste the difference that love (and a little serenity) can make.

timeline.title: A Fort Wayne kitchen
timeline.text: It started as a simple passion for homemade treats, baked for family and friends.

timeline.title: Baked to order
timeline.text: From classic flavors to bold new creations, each batch is crafted by hand with the finest ingredients and a whole lot of care.

values.title: Made from scratch
values.text: Every treat is made by hand, from scratch, using time-honored techniques.

values.title: The finest ingredients
values.text: Simple, quality ingredients baked for the perfect balance of flavor and texture.

values.title: Treats that bring people together
values.text: Treats should do more than satisfy a sweet tooth — they should spark joy and make every occasion unforgettable.
